snippet_primary: "Etsy? That's more like renting a shelf in a crowded marketplace. Sure, you tap into a built-in audience, but you're competing with a million other makers. You can pretty it up a bit—but you're still boxed into Etsy's layout. And when someone buys from you there, what do they say? 'I got it on Etsy.' Ouch."
